schema_agent.title: Inventory
schema_agent.prompt: Using tools only, list all tables in bronze, silver, gold, and meta. Reply with schema.table names only.
schema_agent.why_ask: Confirms Gateway → MCP → Supabase path before harder work.

schema_agent.title: Sample bronze
schema_agent.prompt: Sample 5 rows from bronze.raw_tickets and describe the messiest columns you see (dates, priority, status, category). Be concrete.
schema_agent.why_ask: Forces sample_rows and shows the agent understands real messiness.

schema_agent.title: Propose silver schema
schema_agent.prompt: Propose a typed silver schema for bronze.raw_tickets. Do not invent columns. Prefer staging table silver.tickets_proposed. Return DDL + transform SQL as JSON with keys ddl, transform_sql, rationale, trust.
schema_agent.why_ask: Core Schema Inference deliverable for the take-home.

schema_agent.title: Type choices
schema_agent.prompt: For created_at, resolved_at, cost, sla_hours, and priority: what Postgres types would you choose and why? Cite evidence from samples or profile_table.
schema_agent.why_ask: Checks prompt quality — rationale, not just DDL dump.

schema_agent.title: Trust vs override
schema_agent.prompt: Would you set trust=safe_to_apply for overwriting production silver.tickets right now? Explain when you would override your own DDL.
schema_agent.why_ask: Evaluation criterion: honesty about agent vs human control.

schema_agent.title: Drift bonus
schema_agent.prompt: If a new bronze column vendor_region appeared tomorrow as free text, what migration DDL and silver transform would you propose? Do not execute destructive SQL.
schema_agent.why_ask: Schema evolution bonus from the assignment.

quality_agent.title: Profile bronze
quality_agent.prompt: Profile bronze.raw_tickets focusing on priority, status, category, cost, and resolved_at. Summarize null rates and cardinality.
quality_agent.why_ask: Core Data Quality profiling path via MCP.

quality_agent.title: High-severity rules
quality_agent.prompt: Propose high-severity cleaning rules for this dataset. For each rule include name, why it matters, and SQL or Python. Return JSON with profile_summary and rules[].
quality_agent.why_ask: Must explain WHY, not only flag anomalies.

quality_agent.title: Priority aliases
quality_agent.prompt: priority has values like hi, HIGH, crit, urgent!!!, ???. Propose a normalization map and explain impact on gold SLA metrics if we skip normalization.
quality_agent.why_ask: Real mess in the CSV; tests business impact reasoning.

quality_agent.title: Date anomalies
quality_agent.prompt: How should we handle resolved_at earlier than created_at, and mixed date formats? Propose rules with severity and why.
quality_agent.why_ask: Known data quality issue in source tickets.

quality_agent.title: Drop-row caution
quality_agent.prompt: Is dropping all rows with empty ticket_id safe? Estimate impact and say whether a human should approve before executing.
quality_agent.why_ask: Tradeoff awareness — agents should not silently delete lots of data.

quality_agent.title: Gold readiness
quality_agent.prompt: After cleaning, which silver fields are required for gold SLA performance and cost_by_assignee models? What still blocks trustworthy aggregations?
quality_agent.why_ask: Links quality work to gold layer usefulness.

memory_session.title: STM recall
turns: Remember our demo codeword is MEDALLION-ALPHA. Reply OK only.
What demo codeword did I set? Reply with the codeword only.
memory_session.why_ask: Validates short-term session memory with same session_id/actor_id.
